recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中，在脂肪與造血細胞之間可見數個組織球，細胞質內塞滿許多約 2–4 μm、周圍帶透明暈的小圓形酵母菌（視野右上及中央最清楚），這種細胞內小型酵母是組織胞漿菌症（histoplasmosis）的線索。
features: Hypercellular marrow-type tissue with scattered adipocytes and mixed hematopoietic precursors, including erythroid cells and eosinophils
Scattered histiocytes with abundant pale granular to foamy cytoplasm
Clusters of tiny (about 2-4 um) round to oval intracytoplasmic yeast forms, each with a central basophilic dot and a clear surrounding halo, best seen at upper right and centre
No granulomas or necrosis evident in this field
Organisms are uniform in size without large or capsule-like forms
describe_en: Section of bone marrow at intermediate power shows cellular marrow with adipocytes, erythroid and granulocytic precursors, and scattered eosinophils. Interspersed are histiocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm containing clusters of small, uniform, round to oval yeast forms measuring about 2-4 um, each with a basophilic centre and a clear halo. Well-formed granulomas and necrosis are not seen in this field. Findings are suggestive of disseminated histoplasmosis, to be confirmed with fungal stains (GMS, PAS), culture or antigen testing.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes are similar in size but contain a rod-shaped kinetoplast next to the nucleus and do not stain with GMS or PAS, whereas Histoplasma yeasts are GMS positive and lack a kinetoplast.
Talaromyces yeasts divide by a central transverse septum and include elongated sausage-shaped forms, rather than budding as uniform oval yeasts.
Cryptococcus is larger and more variable (4-10 um) with a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule and narrow-based budding, unlike these tiny uniform intracellular yeasts.
Toxoplasma bradyzoites are non-budding crescentic organisms within cysts and Pneumocystis cysts are extracellular cup-shaped forms, both differing from intrahistiocytic budding yeasts.
